SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.order_no, o.status, o.trade_mode, o.amount, o.item_id, s.item_title, s.item_image_url, s.item_price, o.buyer_id, buyer.nickname AS buyer_nickname, buyer.avatar_url AS buyer_avatar_url, o.seller_id, seller.nickname AS seller_nickname, seller.avatar_url AS seller_avatar_url, o.created_at, o.updated_at FROM orders o JOIN order_snapshots s ON s.order_id = o.id JOIN users buyer ON buyer.id = o.buyer_id JOIN users seller ON seller.id = o.seller_id
AND o.status = #{status} AND o.buyer_id = #{buyerId} AND o.seller_id = #{sellerId}
AND (o.order_no LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '!' OR s.item_title LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '!')
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC
